chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Why is that young man helping that man to cross the road?

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: That's because he is blind and needs help to cross the road.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Oh! How nice of that man to help him.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Yes, it's always good to help others.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Why, Tia?

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Come Tofu and I'll tell you a story, The Dove and the Ant.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: One hot day, an ant was walking near a river bank.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The poor ant lost its balance and fell inside the water.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Oh! Help me! Please help me! Help me!

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: She screamed for help as the flow of the river was too strong. She was carried away.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Someone please help me! Help me! Please! Someone help me! Help me please! Someone help me! Please help me!

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: A dove was watching all this from a nearby tree. The ant was struggling for life in the water.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The dove felt very sad for the little ant.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Help me! Please help me!

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Oh! No! The little ant is in trouble.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: And he decided to help her.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Help me! Please help me!

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: He said to the ant,

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Don't worry my friend, I will save you.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The dove quickly plucked off a leaf

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: and dropped it into the water near the struggling ant.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The ant moved towards the leaf and climbed up there.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: And the ant reached to the shore safely.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The thankful ant said,

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: I will always be grateful to you for saving my life.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: A few weeks later, the ant saw a bad hunter with a gun.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The hunter was targeting at the dove sitting on the tree.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Guessing what he was about to do, the ant quickly bit him on the heel.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Ouch! You pathetic ant! What have you done?

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: The ant walked away happily as she was able to help the dove in return.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: So Tofu, just the way dove's good deed helped him to get out of danger by the ant,

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: similarly every good deed we do for others will surely come back to us.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Hmmm! I will always help the needy.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: That's like a good boy Tofu.

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Johnny Johnny! Yes Papa!

chunk.title: THE DOVE and THE ANT Story Kids Short Story
chunk.text: Eating sugar? No Papa!
